verdict.rationale: WorkOS is an enterprise authentication and identity platform, not an AI agent or assistant, so acting as an MCP client that consumes tools from plugged-in servers is outside its product role. The MCP evidence covers only server-side roles: an official WorkOS MCP server that agents connect to, and AuthKit for securing customers' MCP servers. Neither of these makes the client axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
